description: Permanently delete a sub-account by ID, removing all of its data. Deleting the last sub-account deletes the organization; a repeated call returns 404. A concurrent deletion of the same sub-account returns 409. Requires `MAILTRAP_ORGANIZATION_ID` and organization admin permissions, and the organization must have the Organization & Sub-accounts feature enabled (403 otherwise).

sub_account_id.description: ID of the sub-account to delete.

name: delete-sub-account
